thread:
nora (PM): Quick sync: posted a mini prototype that collapses the roles matrix into a dense list and adds SSO enforcement inline in the invite flow. Need quick feedback on copy + keyboard flow. figma: https://figma.com/file/roles-dense

reza (Designer): Looks good for power users. Two things: the SSO indicator is currently lowercase helper text; it should be more visible as policy.

dana (Frontend): I can make it a pill + info icon. Also need to fix tab order  currently the send button is before the SSO control on mobile.

omar (Backend): Backend note: we'll add `sso_required` to roles endpoint and include an `audit_event_id` in invite responses for deep-linking. No issues.

miri (a11y): A11y checklist: 1) pill must meet 4.5:1 contrast. 2) SR should announce when a selected role requires SSO. 3) ensure focus returns after any modal.

reza (Designer): Copy options for the pill: "SSO only" vs "Requires SSO". Short wins in tight UI. I'll make pill filled and include 16px info button (aria-label).

dana (Frontend): I vote "SSO only". Plan: pill tabbable, info opens modal with heading + explainer; add `aria-live="polite"` node for SR announcements on role selection.

miri (a11y): For screen reader announce use: "Selected role: Billing Admin. Requires SSO." Use live region update on selection. Also add `aria-describedby` from role to the pill where appropriate.

reza (Designer): I'll move the SSO pill ahead of the CTA in the layout so it's not missed. Also adding a small "why" link pointing to docs.

dana (Frontend): Keyboard nav: arrow keys to navigate rows, Enter to select, then focus goes to SSO pill. I'll ensure `role="row"` + `aria-rowindex` and outline on row focus.

omar (Backend): For audit deep-links we'll accept `?highlight=invite:<event_id>` and return the event id in invite create response. Frontend should scroll and add a short highlight class.

miri (a11y): Highlight must respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. For focusable highlight, use a visible border and short duration. Test with NVDA/VoiceOver.

ui-bot: note: small UI change flagged; no infra changes required.

nora (PM): Timeline: Reza updates figma today, Omar adds API fields today, Dana starts frontend PR tomorrow, Miri will do a11y review after PR. Ping here for blockers.

reza (Designer): Uploaded new frames: https://figma.com/file/roles-dense?node-id=6:10  pill moved, higher contrast, info modal copy added.

dana (Frontend): Starting keyboard + live region PR now. Will post link when available.

miri (a11y): I'll run quick SR pass once PR is up. Also please add tests mentioning focus return behavior.

nora (PM): Thanks all. If anyone sees an edge case (bulk CSV invites, delegated invites) call it out here.
